title: ScalingDecision
description: Output schema for Module 3 (Decision Engine) specifying policy-guarded scaling/mitigation recommendations.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision recommendation.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this JSON Schema contract.

service_version.description: Version of the Platform service that generated the decision.

action.description: The recommended infrastructure or traffic action.

reason.description: Deterministic rationale and explanation for the recommended action.

confidence.description: Composite confidence score for the recommendation.

traffic_risk.description: Ingested security risk score from Traffic Intelligence.

predicted_legitimate_rps.description: Ingested predicted legitimate demand from Demand Intelligence.

current_capacity_rps.description: Observed current cluster capacity for this workload.

recommended_pods.description: SentinelScale recommended replica count based on legitimate demand.

baseline_hpa_recommended_pods.description: Replica count that traditional reactive HPA would recommend for raw total load.

pod_delta_vs_baseline.description: Difference in pods (SentinelScale recommended - baseline HPA recommended). Negative means avoided overprovisioning.

policy.description: Policy guardrail identifier enforced (e.g. default-safe-policy, shadow-evaluation-policy).

dry_run.description: Safety flag: must be true to prevent automatic actuation.

shadow_mode.description: Flag indicating decision is running in shadow comparison mode.
